description: Extract color tokens: brand colors, semantic colors, neutral scales, and any CSS custom properties related to color.
Extract typography tokens: font families, sizes, weights, line heights, letter spacing, and type scale.
Extract spacing tokens: padding, margin, gap values, and any spacing scale in use.
Extract layout tokens: column counts, gutters, container max-widths, and breakpoint definitions.
Catalog reusable UI components: buttons, inputs, cards, navigation patterns, and their visual properties.
Extract interactive state styles: hover, focus, active, disabled, and error states across components.
Extract animation and transition tokens: durations, easing curves, keyframe patterns, and scroll-driven animations.
Synthesize brand identity, visual personality, and design intent into a concept overview document.
